# Classification models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

101 classification models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: one RGB image. Output: ImageNet-1k class logits.

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses one input, 224x224: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured.

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

## AlexNet

AlexNet (Krizhevsky et al. 2012): five convolutions and three fully connected layers; an early deep convolutional classifier.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alexnet.tv_in1k` | synthetic (224x224) | original (fp32)<br>original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 1.17<br>1.82<br>0.970<br>0.604<br>0.824<br>0.401 | 271 / 284<br>383 / 404<br>151 / 224<br>184 / 228<br>183 / 204<br>278 / 312 |

- `alexnet.tv_in1k` 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 4 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 13 s (ONNX + engine).
- `alexnet.tv_in1k` original 224x224: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
- `alexnet.tv_in1k` load / first call: original 2.51 s / 0.811 s, portable 1.3 s / 0.016 s, kernels 1.4 s / 0.055 s
- Protocol, median of 9 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

### Measured

fastforks: the model's own resize / crop on the GPU; original: the library's pretrained loader and its PIL eval transform. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Measured on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130, fastforks 939adfe8, 2026-11-06.

### Parity

## ConvNeXt

Meta's ConvNeXt (Liu et al. 2022; tiny, small, base, large; ImageNet-1k, and ImageNet-22k fine-tuned at 224 and 384): a convolutional classifier of 7x7 depthwise convolutions, LayerNorm and MLP blocks. Apache-2.0.

Commercial use: yes.

- Kernel libraries: `cudnn_hacc`, `fvm_conv`, `fvm_extra`, `fvm_mb`, `fvm_r3`
- Variants: `wd-vit-tagger-v3`, `wd-convnext-tagger-v3`, `wd-vit-large-tagger-v3`, `wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3`
- Outputs: logits; label_set: `wd-tagger-v3`; probs: `sigmoid`
- Input size: fixed 448x448: the input is resized (short side 448) and centre-cropped to it
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `wd-vit-tagger-v3` 448x448 (0.2 GiB peak allocated, 0.3 reserved); `wd-convnext-tagger-v3` 448x448 (0.3 GiB peak allocated, 0.4 reserved); `wd-vit-large-tagger-v3` 448x448 (0.7 GiB peak allocated, 0.7 reserved); `wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3` 448x448 (0.7 GiB peak allocated, 0.9 reserved)
- `wd-vit-tagger-v3` 448x448, first call: portable + torch.compile 10 s (cold Inductor cache).
- `wd-convnext-tagger-v3` 448x448, first call: portable + torch.compile 12 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 40 s (ONNX + engine).
- `wd-vit-large-tagger-v3` 448x448, first call: portable + torch.compile 14 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 36 s (ONNX + engine).
- `wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3` 448x448, first call: portable + torch.compile 22 s (cold Inductor cache).
- `wd-vit-tagger-v3` original 448x448: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs
- `wd-convnext-tagger-v3` original 448x448: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs
- `wd-vit-large-tagger-v3` original 448x448: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs
- `wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3` original 448x448: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs
- `wd-vit-tagger-v3` load / first call: original 2.33 s / 0.318 s (448x448), portable 2.44 s / 0.09 s (448x448), kernels 2.28 s / 0.092 s (448x448)
- `wd-convnext-tagger-v3` load / first call: original 2.92 s / 0.484 s (448x448), portable 2.72 s / 0.273 s (448x448), kernels 2.4 s / 0.096 s (448x448)
- `wd-vit-large-tagger-v3` load / first call: original 4.74 s / 0.439 s (448x448), portable 5.54 s / 0.091 s (448x448), kernels 4.68 s / 0.063 s (448x448)
- `wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3` load / first call: original 4.82 s / 0.352 s (448x448), portable 5.38 s / 0.064 s (448x448), kernels 3.61 s / 0.076 s (448x448)
- Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1.5e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.015 and p99 <= 0.052 (absolute error of the output `logits`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wd-vit-tagger-v3` | 0.00717 / 0.02504 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400`, `fvm_conv@f1d064e539e1:sm_120`, `fvm_extra@3208ce525a91:sm_120`, `fvm_mb@720dd3f29bf7:sm_120`, `fvm_r3@f54eb890e23c:sm_120` |
| `wd-convnext-tagger-v3` | 0.01015 / 0.0344 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400`, `fvm_conv@f1d064e539e1:sm_120`, `fvm_extra@3208ce525a91:sm_120`, `fvm_mb@720dd3f29bf7:sm_120`, `fvm_r3@f54eb890e23c:sm_120` |
| `wd-vit-large-tagger-v3` | 0.00643 / 0.02243 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400`, `fvm_conv@f1d064e539e1:sm_120`, `fvm_extra@3208ce525a91:sm_120`, `fvm_mb@720dd3f29bf7:sm_120`, `fvm_r3@f54eb890e23c:sm_120` |
| `wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3` | 0.00947 / 0.03264 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400`, `fvm_conv@f1d064e539e1:sm_120`, `fvm_extra@3208ce525a91:sm_120`, `fvm_mb@720dd3f29bf7:sm_120`, `fvm_r3@f54eb890e23c:sm_120` |

### Limitations

- An image with an alpha channel is not composited on white first, as the reference script does: pass RGB.

</details>
